title: Design versioned odd-byte GF16 tail profile
description: The current GF16 symbol/wire representation cannot provide a universal fixed-B-byte MDS contract for odd B; commit d748620 documents the counterexample and safely supports every positive even length. Define the explicit new mathematics/API/wire identity needed for odd byte tails, comparing padded wire storage, GF8-hybrid final-byte coding, and paired-stripe semantics. Implement the selected versioned profile or revise the public contract with a proof-backed limitation. Never silently change legacy_high_v1 or low_v1.
acceptance_criteria: A source-backed design selects or rejects each candidate; serialized profile/field identity and exact shard-storage semantics are specified; direct algebra proves systematic/MDS behavior for the selected construction; byte sizes 1..65 and 1023..1025 pass direct differential, guards, ASan and UBSan under the new identifier; legacy/even-byte outputs remain bit-identical; migration and incompatibility are documented.

Build an independently enumerated expected dimension/mode set rather than relying only on a total-count assertion, publish the new exact cardinality, preserve executable/result/output hashes and exact expected-cell validation, and document host-isolation requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Lightweight schema/cardinality negative tests pass; an isolated representative AB/BA trial proves pairing integrity; the required manifest is resumable; oversized cells record unavailable rather than failing; larger GF16 analogues, reuse=1/8/64/1024, independently varied batch, automatic nonzero-loss rows, and counterbalanced path order are all explicitly enumerated.

description: An earlier 4KiB/loss=1 result was contaminated by concurrent correctness work and is explicitly discarded. Run reversed-order pinned comparisons across scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 and neighboring shard sizes, scope automatic dispatch only to evidence, add forced-specialized/generic diagnostics, and preserve wire format.
acceptance_criteria: Two pinned reversed-order runs cover scalar, SSSE3, and AVX2 from 64B through 1MiB with binary hashes and setup separate from execution; promoted cells improve at least 5% without >2% neighboring regression; automatic/forced-generic/forced-specialized outputs match; Release, ASan+UBSan, and backend matrices pass; discarded evidence is documented.
notes: Completed in ba41eee. Two CPU0-pinned reversed-order runs used clean pre-dispatch commit 50e7858 binaries for scalar, SSSE3, and AVX2, 64 B through 1 MiB, 15 samples and 3 warmups. At promoted 256 B through 1 MiB anchors generic improved 5.18-32.13 percent; 64-byte AVX2 was excluded. Committed artifact SHA-256 76abe8d88f6c2e8d7220b6b6f784e8a0f3f2f502953491a13f280efa36bf5c0c retains raw-input hashes, binary identities, setup and execution separately, and exact AB/BA order. Automatic, forced-generic, and forced-specialized outputs match. Final Release, ASan+UBSan, and setarch-R TSan each passed 13/13. Fresh backend matrix auto/scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 passed with matrix SHA-256 5bfa8137f2c223b061e9eca4b19623c33129e1572ed10a6aef2b9b6ec7b52037 and source fingerprint 7061c28ac8747c48cbe08a796674e12c42d1ceee65105670440d992743efcc53. Evidence is one AMD microarchitecture; dispatch remains tightly scoped and diagnostic overrides remain available.

description: Implement no-loss no-op, R=1 XOR encode/decode, tiny K/R direct encoding and direct systematic evaluation, bounded LxL small-loss recovery, deterministic measured dispatch thresholds, and direct-path parity subset support. Combined Release and ASan+UBSan 11/11, 2,048 random patterns/24,962 recovered, boundary 108 cases, and scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 determinism passed. title: Experiment C2: truncated dyadic LCH transform preserving parent
description: Hypothesis: A true truncated forward/inverse LCH transform can avoid materializing unused dyadic-parent suffixes while preserving the exact existing parent code. Implement enclosing-power-of-two transforms with exact active input prefix or sparse mask, exact requested output prefix or mask, complete optimized dyadic blocks plus one irregular boundary, and shifted cosets following Coxon. Oracle: full padded parent transform byte-for-byte; no new coordinate profile is permitted in C2. Benchmark every GF8 K,R<=256 priority region plus representative GF16, setup/reuse, memory traffic, tails, and SIMD regularity. Promotion requires >=10% end-to-end gain, exact legacy/profile parity identity, bounded schedule/code footprint, and no neighboring regression; kill if irregular overhead erases traffic savings.
acceptance_criteria: Forward and inverse truncated transforms match the padded parent for exhaustive GF4 and large GF8/GF16 masks/shifts; legacy-compatible parity is byte-identical; setup/execution and memory traffic are separate; sanitizers/backend determinism pass; any exact-code variant is rejected from C2 and assigned a new versioned profile task.
notes: Scalar C2 checkpoint committed in 0564f05. Parent-preserving compact forward/inverse recurrence passed 268,002 plans, 1,107,672 unit vectors, 8,315,600 independent direct-algebra symbol comparisons, and 4,814 padded vectors; repeat artifact was byte-identical.
